description.value: ZUBU Ramen is a multi-location Japanese restaurant group with four Lower Mainland outposts; the Kerrisdale location serves ramen, fresh temaki, hand-made gyoza, and rice bowls in a lively neighbourhood setting. Executive Chef William Cao trained at Kitchen Hyodo Ramen School in Oyama, Japan, and sources ingredients either locally or imported directly from Japan. The chain has received press coverage from the Vancouver Sun, WestCoast Families, and Montecristo Magazine since opening in 2020.
